reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and the "Every batch lab-tested" line, and the sachets are a smart idea for my car and gym bag. But it is a brand I have never heard of with zero reviews and no NSF or USP seal, and I already reorder my Pure Encapsulations or Thorne.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP seal on a brand I do not know. A lab report on their own QR code is nice, but it is their word. Also two capsules per sachet that are probably big size 00 is a pain to swallow.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP seal on the box, plus a few hundred real reviews. A smaller capsule or a lower price for a trial box would also help.
